decisions.statement: This table is written out from the companion pages rather than by hand.
These bytes are the last good build rather than the table the generator emits today.
The generator reads a field the trait pages no longer have.
A regeneration today zeroes the effect type on every trait.
A trait's place in this table is the index a build hash has.
A trait moved to another place breaks every build hash saved.
